description: Modification times shared by the Rust and Swift scanner tests. Each file is created at path (relative to the scan root) with its modified time in Unix seconds. A folder's newest time is the newest of any file below it; null means it has none. Times before 1970 count as 1970-01-01T00:00:01Z.

olderThan.description: scan --older-than keeps these entries, in depth-first order, for any cutoff after 1650000000 and up to 1700000000.
